pricing.description: Three starting points. Every proposal is scoped to fit your project's actual needs.
pricing.footnote: Not sure which package fits? Reach out and we'll recommend the right scope, no strings attached.

express.name: Landing Express
express.desc: For one-off campaigns or a launch that can't wait.
features: 1 professional landing page focused on a single offer
Forms connected to email or CRM

growth.name: Growth

features: Case study, FAQ and objection-handling sections
Email marketing integration and welcome flows

faq.description: Everything people ask us before getting started. Don't see yours? Reach out and we'll answer within 24 hours.

items.q: How much does a landing page cost?
items.a: Our packages start at $120–200 USD (Landing Express), $300–500 USD (Growth) and $500–1,000+ USD (Pro · SaaS). Every proposal is scoped to the project's actual needs. Want a recommendation?

items.q: How long does a project take?
items.a: A Landing Express ships in 3–5 business days. Growth and Pro projects take 14 to 30 days depending on scope.
We build on Webflow for fast turnaround, and Next.js when you need APIs, dashboards or AI integrations. Automations run on n8n, Make or Zapier.
Yes. We build Shopify stores and custom Next.js catalogs with optimized checkout and technical SEO.

items.q: Do you write the copy and content?
items.a: Yes, every package includes conversion-focused strategic copy. If you already have content, we'll refine it.
Yes. We integrate OpenAI-powered agents, automations with n8n/Make, and connections to CRM, the WhatsApp API and email marketing.
Three steps: (1) a discovery call, (2) proposal and quote, (3) kickoff. Reach us at hola@asahi.studio or on WhatsApp.

items.q: Do you work with clients outside Mexico?
items.a: Yes. We're based in CDMX and Guadalajara, but work 100% remote with clients across LATAM, the EU and the US.
Yes, we offer monthly maintenance plans and ongoing consulting after launch.
